description:
Open the architectural floorplan at '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/floorplan.dxf'. Create a new layer named 'SAFETY' with Color set to Red and Line Width set to 0.50mm. On this new layer, draw the following safety elements:

1. Evacuation Route: A continuous path (Line or Polyline) starting at (300, 300), going to (300, 600), and ending at the exit at (800, 600).
2. 'You Are Here' Marker: A Circle centered at (300, 300) with a radius of 25.
3. Fire Extinguisher Symbol: A 50x50 Square centered at (500, 300) (corners at 475,275 and 525,325).
4. Text Labels: Add text 'YOU ARE HERE' near the circle, 'EXIT' near the route end, and 'FE' near the square.

Save the completed drawing as '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/evacuation_plan.dxf'.
